job.title: [Post] Amshini Magaima - 1. SAP Gatp Functional Analyst

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) & Sales Order Management Developer
tailoring.summary: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, Sales Order Management (OMS), and data integrations between PIM, ERP and e-commerce channels. Experienced in techno-functional roles analyzing requirements, designing data flows, and collaborating with international stakeholders. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Gatp Functional Analyst
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the SAP Gatp Functional Analyst role. With over 5 years of professional experience specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) and Sales Order Management (OMS) across major enterprise projects at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep techno-functional expertise aligning complex business requirements with robust backend solutions.

bullets.label: SAP Hybris & Order Management
bullets.text: Developed and maintained core SAP Commerce modules including the Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), and custom Impex and Cronjob scripts for enterprise platforms.

bullets.label: Integration & Data Flows
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and PIM platforms, ensuring seamless data synchronization across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: REST APIs & OCC Services
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for custom data flows.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Analysis
bullets.text: Bridged business and technical teams by analyzing requirements, writing user stories and functional specifications, and translating them into scalable SAP Commerce solutions.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and am serving a notice period until 15 December 2026, making me available to start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my expertise aligns with your requirements.

tailoring.why_company: I want to apply my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and Order Management expertise to help drive scalable, high-performance enterprise solutions for your clients, bridging business requirements and technical execution effectively.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leveraging 5+ years of SAP Hybris and Order Management expertise to deliver robust integration and techno-functional solutions in remote enterprise environments.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I bring 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) and Order Management expertise, with strong experience bridging business requirements and technical integrations. My CV is attached, and I am available from 16.12.2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.offer: I bring 5+ years of hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud and Order Management experience to rapidly support your integration initiatives and stabilize backend data flows. My strong techno-functional background ensures seamless collaboration between business stakeholders and technical teams from day one.
tailoring.email_subject: Application - SAP Gatp Functional Analyst - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with over 5 years of professional experience building and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms and Order Management systems at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I bring strong expertise in SAP Hybris, RESTful APIs, and techno-functional analysis, bridging business requirements with robust backend solutions. Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, I am available starting 16.12.2026. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
